token.name: Prediction Markets Run by AI Agents

notes: VerdictToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 VERDICT to msg.sender once. It has no transfer fees, external mint or burn functions, or administrative controls. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
